en.title: Case Converter: text case styles and how to switch them
en.description: Learn when to use sentence case, title case, camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case, and how to convert text between them in common editors.
en.lede: Sentence case, title case, camelCase, snake_case: each style has a place. Here is when to use which, and how to convert text in the editors you already have.

steps.title: Pick the style for the job
steps.body: Use sentence case for body text and most headings, title case for formal titles, camelCase or snake_case for code identifiers, and kebab-case for URLs and file names.

steps.title: Convert in a word processor
steps.body: In Word, select the text and press Shift+F3 to cycle through lowercase, UPPERCASE and Capitalize Each Word. In Google Docs, use Format, then Text, then Capitalization.

steps.title: Convert in a code editor
steps.body: In VS Code, open the command palette and run Transform to Uppercase, Lowercase or Title Case. Extensions add camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case conversion.

steps.title: Check names and acronyms
steps.body: Automatic conversion lowercases acronyms and proper nouns. Look over the result and restore names like NASA or iPhone by hand.

faq: What is the difference between sentence case and title case?
Sentence case capitalises only the first word and proper nouns, like a normal sentence. Title case capitalises most words, usually skipping short articles and prepositions such as a, the and of.
Which case should I use in URLs?
Use lowercase kebab-case, such as my-page-title. Search engines treat hyphens as word separators, and lowercase avoids duplicate pages on servers that treat paths as case sensitive.
Why does converting to title case sometimes look wrong?

Style guides disagree on which small words stay lowercase, and software cannot know your proper nouns or brand spellings. Treat the output as a first pass and check it against the style guide you follow.

zh.title: 大小写转换：常见写法的用途和转换方法
zh.description: 了解句首大写、标题大写、camelCase、snake_case 和 kebab-case 各自适用的场景，以及在常用编辑器里怎样互相转换。
zh.lede: 句首大写、标题大写、camelCase、snake_case，每种写法各有用处。这里说明什么时候用哪一种，以及怎样在现有编辑器里完成转换。

steps.title: 按用途选择写法
steps.body: 正文和多数标题用句首大写，正式标题用标题大写，代码标识符用 camelCase 或 snake_case，网址和文件名用 kebab-case。

steps.title: 在文字处理软件里转换
steps.body: 在 Word 中选中文字后按 Shift+F3，可在小写、大写和每个单词首字母大写之间切换。在 Google 文档中使用“格式”、“文字”、“大小写”。

steps.title: 在代码编辑器里转换
steps.body: 在 VS Code 中打开命令面板，运行“转换为大写”“转换为小写”或“转换为词首大写”。安装扩展后还能转换 camelCase、snake_case 和 kebab-case。

steps.title: 检查人名和缩写
steps.body: 自动转换会把缩写和专有名词改成小写。转换后通读一遍，把 NASA、iPhone 这类写法手动改回来。

faq: 句首大写和标题大写有什么区别？
句首大写只把第一个单词和专有名词的首字母大写，和普通句子一样。标题大写会把大多数单词首字母大写，通常不包括 a、the、of 这类短的冠词和介词。
网址里应该用哪种写法？
使用全小写的 kebab-case，例如 my-page-title。搜索引擎把连字符当作词的分隔符，全小写还能避免区分大小写的服务器产生重复页面。
为什么转换成标题大写有时看起来不对？
不同的风格指南对哪些小词保持小写没有统一规定，软件也不知道你的专有名词和品牌写法。把结果当作初稿，再对照你采用的风格指南检查。
